title: Physics-informed neural networks for strain-dependent bandgaps in diamond: code and data
description:
Code and data for the manuscript Physics-informed neural networks for strain-dependent bandgaps in diamond, submitted to Communications Materials. The models predict the bandgap of diamond under an arbitrary strain, given as the six components of the Green-Lagrange strain tensor, from 1,292 hybrid-functional DFT calculations and two analytic models of the band edges: deformation-potential theory for the conduction band and the Bir-Pikus model for the valence band.

The archive contains the reference dataset, the VASP input files and the relaxed structure of every state; one standalone script per model of the paper (proposed hybrid model PHM, residual model, APHYNITY, SA-PINN, RBA-PINN, NTK-PINN, MLP, conventional regression and the analytic models alone); the training program and the commands of all 2,924 training runs of the paper; the fitted constants of the analytic models; condensed results of every run; and the analysis that recomputes every table, number, statistical test and figure of the paper.
